caseName: Henry v. City of Rock Hill
caseNameFull: HENRY Et Al. v. CITY OF ROCK HILL
attorneys: Jack Greenberg, Constance Baker Motley, Matthew J. Perry, Lincoln C. Jenkins, Jr., Donald James Sampson and Willie T. Smith, Jr. for petitioners., Daniel R. McLeod, Attorney General of South Carolina, and Everett N. Brandon, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the Supreme Court of South Carolina for further consideration in light of Edwards v. South Carolina, 372 U. S. 229.
